details: Editor loads SKILL.md and the full shared procedure before reading design.md, tasks.md, requirements.md and entry.md. Both patch calls modify only design.md/tasks.md. The final Python check reads exactly those same four project files and validates required headings, task state, checkboxes and all local/inbound links without writing files. Each reader reads only its respective design.md, tasks.md and entry.md.
instruction_order: Full entry point/shared procedure before subject-matter reads.
limits: Shared filesystem, enforced by prompt and audited traces rather than OS isolation. Native encrypted dispatch plaintext cannot be decrypted; exact pre-dispatch plaintext and ciphertext linkage are retained.
